title: Harrington tours the Greenbrier bunker

tellings.quote: was later when I was secretary of energy. I got to see that cuz we were down at Greenbryer. I think it was Greenbryer playing golf and I went and toured that thing.

plain: John S. Herrington, who served as US Secretary of Energy, says that while he was in office, around 1986 or 1987, he toured the secret bunker at the Greenbrier, a resort in West Virginia, while he was there to play golf. He tells Michels this first-hand, saying "I went and toured that thing." It shows that a cabinet member saw a hidden government site few people ever entered.
